what: City of Berkeley citywide (all-funds) budget figures for the measure-u site Sankeys. EXTERNAL FACTS with provenance (JN-L pattern) — published numbers, not derivations. Two vintages, deliberately NOT combined into one flow: revenues = FY2025 ACTUALS (the only citywide revenue-by-TYPE source the city publishes, ACFR); spending = FY2027 ADOPTED budget.

sources.ACFR: Annual Comprehensive Financial Report FY2025 (year ended 6/30/2025), https://berkeleyca.gov/sites/default/files/2026-01/annual-comprehensive-financial-report-fy2025.pdf
sources.ADOPT: 2026-06-23 Council Special Item 01, Adoption of FY 2027 and 2028 Biennial Budget + FY 2027-2031 CIP (Exhibit A financial summaries), https://berkeleyca.gov/sites/default/files/2026-06/2026-06-23%20Special%20Item%2001%20Adoption%20of%20Fiscal%20Years%202027%20and%202028.pdf
sources.PRES: 2026-05-14 Budget & Finance Policy Committee, Proposed FY 2027 & FY 2028 Biennial Budget presentation, https://berkeleyca.gov/sites/default/files/legislative-body-meeting-attachments/5.14.26%20Item2%20FY%2027%20-%20FY%2028%20PROPOSED%20BIENNIAL%20BUDGET%20-%20Presentation.pdf
sources.JAN22: 2026-01-22 BFPC FY 2027 and FY 2028 Budget Update slides, https://berkeleyca.gov/sites/default/files/legislative-body-meeting-attachments/Item%2002%20BFPC-FY2728%20Budget%20Update_Final_01.22.26.pdf

revenues_fy2025_actual._source: ACFR MD&A Statement of Activities summary, pp.11-12. Citywide = governmental + business-type activities. Total $619,580,456. The FY27/28 budget publishes NO all-funds revenue-by-type table (only by fund type) — FY2025 actuals are the latest citywide by-type picture. BSEP is a school-district tax and is NOT in city statements. Parking fines are not broken out citywide (GF budgets ~$6.65M/yr, inside charges/other).

spend_fy2027_adopted._source: ADOPT Exhibit A: by category PDF p.139 (PRES slide 35); by department PDF p.137 (PRES slide 33). All-funds net budget FY2027 = $905,190,026 (PRES slide-35 header typo '$905,190,206' — table total is correct and consistent).

pensions._source: ACFR Schedule of Plan Contributions, pp.155-157 (FY2025 actual employer contributions = actuarially determined); rates p.110; net pension liability MD&A p.10. GF-only budget figures: JAN22 slide 9. No citywide FY27 pension dollar line is published.

enterprise_funds_fy2026_adopted._source: BOOK Summary by Funding Source, book pp.44-52 (FY2026 adopted; FY27 enterprise detail not re-published in the adoption exhibits). Inside Public Works except Marina (PRW) and Permit Center (Planning).

ab8_allocation_of_1pct._source: City 32.57% exact (City revenue memo, AB-8 share); schools/county/special approximate from AB-8 structure (Alameda Auditor-Controller glossary). Same facts as JN-L baseline.
